title: AI Manufacturing Engineer
location_raw: United States of America, South Carolina, West Union; United States of America, North Carolina, Raleigh; Austin, TX (Local Office)
description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

The AI Manufacturing Engineer designs, develops, deploys, and supports AI-enabled solutions that enhance manufacturing processes, test systems, product quality, and factory operations. This role combines expertise in industrial engineering, data science, machine learning, software development, and manufacturing systems to solve complex operational challenges in a technology-driven Utilities & Energy environment.

The ideal candidate is passionate about applying artificial intelligence technologies to real-world manufacturing environments and can translate business needs into practical, scalable solutions that improve operational performance, customer outcomes, and business value. The successful candidate demonstrates a customer-centric mindset, accountability for results, and the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.

Duties & Responsibilities

- Develop, train, validate, and deploy machine learning models for manufacturing applications.

- Build predictive analytics solutions that improve product quality, throughput, equipment reliability, process optimization, and customer outcomes.

- Design AI-based systems for anomaly detection, defect classification, root-cause analysis, and predictive maintenance.

- Develop computer vision solutions for automated inspection, quality assurance, and manufacturing process verification.

- Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, operations, and test engineering subject matter experts to identify high-value AI use cases and prioritize implementation opportunities.

- Support Industry 4.0 initiatives through the deployment of AI-enabled manufacturing solutions that drive operational excellence and innovation.

- Integrate AI applications with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platforms, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems, manufacturing databases, test systems, and production equipment.

- Create dashboards, monitoring tools, and decision-support systems that transform manufacturing data into actionable insights.

- Implement digital twins and process simulation capabilities to improve manufacturing efficiency and decision-making.

- Develop scalable data pipelines for structured and unstructured manufacturing data from production, quality, and operational systems.

- Ensure model accuracy, reproducibility, data integrity, cybersecurity requirements, and regulatory compliance.

- Establish and maintain best practices for AI governance, model monitoring, lifecycle management, and responsible AI deployment.

- Partner with Manufacturing Engineering teams to improve production yields, cycle times, Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), capacity utilization, and process stability.

- Support New Product Introduction (NPI) activities through data-driven manufacturing analytics and process optimization.

- Collaborate with Test Engineering teams to improve automated test coverage, diagnostic capability, and test efficiency.

- Participate in continuous improvement initiatives using AI-driven insights and data-informed decision making.

- Work cross-functionally with Operations, Quality, Product Development, Supply Chain, Information Technology, and other stakeholders to deliver business results.

- Communicate technical findings, recommendations, and project outcomes effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Provide guidance, training, and mentorship on AI technologies, advanced analytics, and data-driven decision-making practices.

- Stay current on emerging AI technologies, manufacturing innovations, industry trends, and best practices.

- Demonstrate accountability for project execution, deliverables, and measurable business impact while contributing to a culture of agility, collaboration, authenticity, and innovation.

Required Skills & Experience

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Data Science, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field.

- Experience developing solutions using Python or similar programming languages.

- Experience with MLOps, model deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.

- Experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-Learn, or equivalent technologies.

- Experience with data analysis, statistics, predictive modeling, and advanced analytics techniques.

- Experience working with SQL databases, data processing tools, and large-scale datasets.

- Understanding of manufacturing processes, industrial automation, quality systems, operational environments, or related production systems.

- Experience in manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, test engineering, quality engineering, operations engineering, or related disciplines.

- Experience implementing AI agents and intelligent automation solutions for manufacturing and quality process improvements.

- Experience developing dashboards, reporting tools, and data visualization solutions.

- Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and root-cause investigation skills.

- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and effectively to diverse audiences.

- Ability to work collaboratively across multiple functions, teams, and geographic locations.

- Strong project management, execution, and organizational skills.

- Demonstrated ability to deliver customer-focused solutions that drive operational improvements and business results.

- Commitment to continuous learning, innovation, accountability, and inclusive collaboration.

Preferred Skills & Experience

- Experience with computer vision, industrial image processing, and automated inspection technologies.

- Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure and cloud-based AI services.

- Knowledge of Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), MES, SCADA, PLCs, industrial control systems, and manufacturing data platforms.

- Experience deploying AI and machine learning solutions in production manufacturing environments.

- Familiarity with Statistical Process Control (SPC), Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, or continuous improvement methodologies.

- Knowledge of electronics manufacturing, utility products, smart metering technologies, test systems, industrial equipment, or energy-focused manufacturing operations.

- Experience working with digital twin technologies, simulation tools, or advanced manufacturing analytics platforms.

- Familiarity with data governance, responsible AI practices, cybersecurity principles, and regulatory compliance requirements.

- Experience supporting smart factory, connected factory, or Industry 4.0 transformation initiatives.

- Advanced degree in a relevant engineering, computer science, data science, or analytics discipline.

Benefits Info:
This position also includes a competitive benefit package including; financial, social, health and wellbeing programs, paid vacation, 401k matching, employee stock purchase program, hybrid work schedule, and more!

title: Financial Planning & Analysis Specialist
location_raw: United States of America, Washington, Liberty Lake
description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

This role serves as a strategic finance partner to the Outcomes Research & Development (R&D) organization, enabling innovation and value creation within a technology-driven Utilities & Energy environment. The position provides end-to-end financial planning, analysis, and operational support across actuals, budgets, forecasts, and long-range plans. By delivering clear insights, scalable planning tools, and scenario-based analysis, this role helps R&D leaders make informed, customer-centric investment decisions. The role collaborates closely with the Project Management Office (PMO), engineering, and senior R&D and corporate leaders to support effective resource allocation, portfolio health, and continuous improvement.

Duties & Responsibilities

- Act as an accountable finance partner to the global R&D organization, supporting innovation initiatives that deliver long-term customer and business value in the Utilities & Energy sector.

- Prepare, analyze, and present monthly and quarterly financial reporting for global R&D spend, highlighting key drivers, variances, risks, and opportunities, and recommending agile corrective actions when needed.

- Lead and support the development of annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and long-range plans for R&D, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities, innovation roadmaps, and customer outcomes.

- Drive continuous improvement of R&D budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes, increasing transparency, efficiency, and cross-functional collaboration.

- Analyze R&D investment profiles at the project and portfolio level, evaluating spend efficiency, portfolio health, and the financial impact of new product development and innovation pipelines.

- Develop, maintain, and refine financial models that support scenario planning, investment governance, and executive-level decision-making.

- Partner closely with global R&D leaders, engineering teams, and the PMO to incorporate project updates, resource changes, and timeline shifts into financial plans and forecasts.

- Collaborate with R&D operating expense owners to ensure accurate forecasting, insightful variance analysis, and disciplined financial management tied to key strategic initiatives.

- Manage ad hoc reporting and analysis requests, validate data inputs, resolve discrepancies, and uphold high standards of financial accuracy and integrity.

- Support and lead strategic and operational initiatives related to R&D transformation, resource planning, and investment optimization, acting as a proactive change agent.

Required Skills & Experience

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related business discipline.

- 3–5 years of experience in FP&A, strategic finance, or a related analytical finance role.

- Demonstrated ability to partner authentically with cross-functional stakeholders and influence decision-making through data-driven insights.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of accountability and attention to detail.

- Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment while managing multiple priorities with agility.

- Clear and confident communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial information to diverse audiences.

Preferred Skills & Experience

- MBA and/or PMP certification.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; experience with Power BI preferred.

- Advanced working knowledge of Oracle Cloud EPM Planning or a similar cube-based planning and reporting platform.

- Experience building and managing financial models to drive insight, support scenario planning, and identify optimization opportunities.

- Comfort challenging the status quo, influencing change, and driving continuous improvement in a collaborative, innovative culture.

- Strong organizational skills and the ability to drive progress in a hybrid work environment (virtual and in-office).

Benefits Info:
This position also includes a competitive benefit package including; financial, social, health and wellbeing programs, paid vacation, 401k matching, employee stock purchase program, hybrid work schedule, and more!

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience and may vary by location. The base salary is $75,000-124,500 annually. This position is eligible for our annual bonus program.

title: DevOps Engineer
location_raw: United States of America, Illinois, Chicago
description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

At Itron, we help utilities modernize critical infrastructure through digital solutions that connect the field, office, and enterprise. As part of our Locusview product line, our fast-growing Resiliency Solutions business, you'll combine the agility of a startup with the scale of an industry leader while helping drive the future of utility infrastructure.

Position Overview
The DevOps Engineer plays a critical role in designing, building, and maintaining the cloud infrastructure, automation frameworks, and deployment pipelines that power our technology platform. This individual partners closely with software engineering, product, and operations teams to deliver scalable, secure, and highly available solutions that support utility and energy customers. Success in this role requires a customer-centric mindset, strong technical expertise, continuous improvement, and a commitment to collaboration, accountability, and innovation.

Duties & Responsibilities

- Design, implement, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines to accelerate software delivery while maintaining quality, security, and reliability.

- Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to design, deploy, and optimize cloud-native infrastructure solutions that support business growth and customer success.

- Own and support production-grade environments, ensuring high availability, resiliency, performance, and operational excellence.

- Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using Terraform and industry best practices.

- Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize cloud infrastructure and services to proactively identify and resolve issues.

- Automate operational processes and repetitive tasks to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability.

- Partner with development teams to enhance application deployment strategies, system architecture, and operational readiness.

- Support security, compliance, and infrastructure governance initiatives across cloud environments.

- Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, innovation, accountability, and agile delivery.

- Act as a trusted technical partner, helping deliver reliable solutions that enable utility customers to modernize and strengthen critical infrastructure.

Required Skills & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 4+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Cloud Engineering, or a related role supporting production environments.

- Hands-on experience with Docker and containerization technologies.

- Experience with container orchestration platforms, including Amazon ECS and/or Kubernetes (EKS).

- Strong knowledge of AWS services, including VPC, ECS, EKS, EC2, Route 53, S3, SQS, SNS, ElastiCache, OpenSearch, and AWS Transfer Family.

- Proven experience developing and managing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, including creating and implementing reusable modules.

- Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, or similar technologies.

- Experience supporting and maintaining production infrastructure with a focus on reliability, scalability, and performance.

- Knowledge of cloud monitoring and security tools such as CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and GuardDuty.

- Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language, such as Python, Bash, Groovy, or similar.

- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.

- Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, agile environment and communicate technical concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders.

- Demonstrated commitment to accountability, customer focus, and delivering high-quality results.

Preferred Skills & Experience

- Experience supporting SaaS platforms and large-scale cloud-native applications.

- Knowledge of observability, monitoring, and logging best practices.

- Experience implementing DevSecOps practices and cloud security frameworks.

- Familiarity with microservices architectures and distributed systems.

- Experience working within the Utilities, Energy, Infrastructure, Telecommunications, or related industries.

- Knowledge of application performance monitoring and incident management processes.

- AWS certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, SysOps Administrator) or equivalent cloud certifications.

- Experience optimizing infrastructure costs and improving operational efficiency.

- Passion for technology innovation and helping customers solve complex operational challenges.

- Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment while fostering authentic and collaborative relationships.

title: Principal FP&A - Networked Solutions PBU
location_raw: United States of America, Washington, Liberty Lake; United States of America, North Carolina, Raleigh; United States of America, South Carolina, West Union
description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

The Principal Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Analyst serves as a key strategic partner to the Networked Solutions Product Business Unit (PBU), providing financial leadership, business insight, and operational support. This role is responsible for delivering accurate and actionable financial reporting, analyzing variances across actuals, budgets, forecasts, and long-range plans, and driving data-informed decision-making. The Principal FP&A Analyst leads complex financial modeling and performance analysis, identifies risks and opportunities, and collaborates with cross-functional teams and senior leadership to support strategic planning, operational excellence, and business growth.

Duties & Responsibilities

- Partner with Networked Solutions PBU leadership to provide strategic financial guidance, enabling informed decision-making and alignment with organizational objectives.

- Prepare and present monthly and quarterly financial analyses for global consolidations, clearly communicating key business drivers, variances, trends, risks, and opportunities while recommending corrective actions.

- Lead the development of annual budgets, long-range financial plans, forecasts, and monthly outlooks, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and accountability across the planning process.

- Continuously evaluate and improve budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes to enhance efficiency, accuracy, scalability, and business agility.

- Analyze revenue performance, customer and product profitability, supply chain impacts, and new product development investments to identify actionable insights and optimization opportunities.

- Develop, maintain, and enhance complex financial models that support strategic planning, investment analysis, business case development, and executive decision-making.

- Collaborate with global business functions, operational teams, and product leadership to incorporate evolving business requirements into financial plans and forecasts.

- Serve as a trusted financial advisor to operating expense (OpEx) leaders by owning forecasting and reporting processes, identifying emerging trends, assessing business impacts, and recommending solutions that improve operational effectiveness.

- Deliver insightful performance reporting that promotes accountability, supports continuous improvement, and advances customer-centric business outcomes.

- Leverage technology, analytics, and innovative approaches, including AI-enabled tools where appropriate, to improve reporting quality, forecasting accuracy, and business insights.

- Validate financial data, investigate variances, troubleshoot reporting issues, and ensure the integrity and accuracy of financial results.

- Lead or support strategic and operational special projects, providing financial analysis and recommendations to business stakeholders.

- Build collaborative relationships with cross-functional partners and senior leadership to influence decisions, align priorities, and drive organizational success.

Required Skills & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

- 5+ years of experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), strategic finance, corporate finance, or a similar analytical finance role.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling, scenario analysis, forecasting, and data interpretation.

- Demonstrated experience preparing financial reports, budgets, forecasts, and variance analyses for business leadership.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable business insights.

- Proven expertise building, maintaining, and enhancing complex financial models that support strategic planning and operational decision-making.

- Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to effectively engage stakeholders at all organizational levels.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

- Demonstrated ability to challenge conventional thinking, act as a change agent, and successfully drive process improvements.

- Proven ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment while maintaining strong collaboration, accountability, and results orientation.

- Commitment to customer-centric thinking, business partnership, continuous improvement, and delivering high-quality outcomes.

Preferred Skills & Experience

- MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

- Experience with Oracle Cloud EPM Planning or other cube-based planning and reporting platforms.

- Proficiency with Microsoft Power BI and advanced data visualization tools.

- Experience utilizing AI-enabled technologies to enhance reporting, forecasting, planning, or business decision-making.

- Experience supporting product-based organizations, technology companies, or businesses serving the Utilities & Energy sector.

- Demonstrated success partnering with senior leaders to influence strategic decisions and business performance.

- Knowledge of customer profitability analysis, supply chain finance, and new product development financial evaluation.

- Experience leading cross-functional initiatives focused on innovation, operational efficiency, and business transformation.
